task: ae.lr: SLR/LALR(1)/canonical LR(1) parser generator (FIRST/FOLLOW, item sets, conflict reports, table-driven parser) with exhaustive language-oracle and random-grammar differential tests and a 21-mutant check
reasoning_summary: Built the LR(0)/canonical LR(1) automaton once and derived SLR (FOLLOW reduces), LR1 and LALR (merge by core) from it, recording conflicts per cell. Tests are dragon-book literals (12/12/22 states), an exhaustive fixed-point language oracle, and 400 seeded random grammars checking SLR-free => LALR-free => LR1-free and LALR states == LR(0) states. A 21-mutant pass killed every mutant.
